mechanism: Naproxen may reduce renal clearance of primaquine metabolites and increase risk of hemolytic toxicity, particularly in G6PD-deficient patients; NSAIDs also increase risk of acute kidney injury which can elevate primaquine levels.
action: Monitor renal function and hemoglobin closely; consider alternative analgesic if possible; ensure adequate hydration and assess G6PD status before primaquine use.
